function _get_precision(backend::String, precision::DotPrecision)
    if backend == "gpu" && precision == F32_F32
        return 3
    else

function einsum_with_dot_precision(subscript::String, a::AbstractArray, b::AbstractArray; precision::DotPrecision)
    a_converted = convert(Array{precision.operand_dtype}, a)
    b_converted = convert(Array{precision.operand_dtype}, b)
    
    result = einsum(subscript, a_converted, b_converted)
    
    backend = lowercase(get(ENV, "JULIA_BACKEND", "cpu"))
    jax_precision = _get_precision(backend, precision)
    
    return convert(Array{precision.accumulator_dtype}, result)
end

function _softmax(x::AbstractArray)
    dtype = promote_type(eltype(x), Float32)
    x_max = maximum(convert(Array{dtype}, x), dims=ndims(x))
    unnormalized = exp.(x .- x_max)
    denom = sum(unnormalized, dims=ndims(x))
    return unnormalized ./ denom
end

struct XlaDotProductAttention end

function _attend(
    q::AbstractArray,
    k::AbstractArray,
    v::AbstractArray;
    q_k_dot_precision::DotPrecision,
    logits_dtype::DataType,
    logits_scale::Float64,
    bias::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing},
    mask::Union{Mask, Nothing},
    weights_v_dot_precision::DotPrecision,
    q_indices::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing},
    k_indices::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing}
)
    logits = einsum_with_dot_precision("...qhd,...khd->...hqk", q, k, precision=q_k_dot_precision)
    logits = convert(Array{logits_dtype}, logits)
    
    logits = logits .* logits_scale
    
    if bias !== nothing
        logits = logits .+ bias
    end
    
    if mask !== nothing
        q_len_or_indices = q_indices === nothing ? size(q, ndims(q)-2) : length(q_indices)
        k_len_or_indices = k_indices === nothing ? size(k, ndims(k)-2) : length(k_indices)
        mask_array = as_array(mask, q_len_or_indices, k_len_or_indices)
        
        mask_value = float(typemin(eltype(logits)))
        logits = Base.ifelse.(mask_array, logits, mask_value)
    end
    
    weights = _softmax(logits)
    weights = convert(Array{eltype(v)}, weights)
    
    out = einsum_with_dot_precision("...hqk,...khd->...qhd", weights, v, precision=weights_v_dot_precision)
    out = convert(Array{eltype(q)}, out)
    
    return out
end

function einsum(subscript::String, arrays::AbstractArray...)
    if subscript == "...qhd,...khd->...hqk"
        return compute_attention_scores(arrays[1], arrays[2])
    elseif subscript == "...hqk,...khd->...qhd"
        return compute_attention_output(arrays[1], arrays[2])
    else
        error("Unsupported einsum operation: $subscript")
    end
end

function compute_attention_scores(q::AbstractArray, k::AbstractArray)
    q_shape = size(q)
    k_shape = size(k)
    
    q_reshaped = reshape(q, prod(q_shape[1:end-2]), q_shape[end-1], q_shape[end])
    k_reshaped = reshape(k, prod(k_shape[1:end-2]), k_shape[end-1], k_shape[end])
    
    scores = Array{Float32}(undef, size(q_reshaped, 1), size(q_reshaped, 2), size(k_reshaped, 2))
    
    for i in 1:size(q_reshaped, 1)
        scores[i, :, :] = q_reshaped[i, :, :] * transpose(k_reshaped[i, :, :])
    end
    
    return reshape(scores, q_shape[1:end-2]..., size(scores, 2), size(scores, 3))
end

function compute_attention_output(weights::AbstractArray, v::AbstractArray)
    weights_shape = size(weights)
    v_shape = size(v)
    
    weights_reshaped = reshape(weights, prod(weights_shape[1:end-2]), weights_shape[end-1], weights_shape[end])
    v_reshaped = reshape(v, prod(v_shape[1:end-2]), v_shape[end-1], v_shape[end])
    
    output = Array{Float32}(undef, size(weights_reshaped, 1), size(weights_reshaped, 2), size(v_reshaped, 3))
    
    for i in 1:size(weights_reshaped, 1)
        output[i, :, :] = weights_reshaped[i, :, :] * v_reshaped[i, :, :]
    end
    
    return reshape(output, weights_shape[1:end-2]..., size(output, 2), v_shape[end])
end

function mask_mean(mask, value; axis=nothing, keepdims=false, eps=1e-10)
    mask_shape = size(mask)
    value_shape = size(value)
    
    @assert length(mask_shape) == length(value_shape) "Shapes are not compatible, shapes: $mask_shape, $value_shape"
    
    if typeof(axis) <: Integer
        axis = [axis]
    elseif axis === nothing
        axis = collect(1:length(mask_shape))
    end
    
    @assert typeof(axis) <: AbstractArray "axis needs to be either an iterable, integer or \"nothing\""
    
    broadcast_factor = 1.0
    for axis_ in axis
        value_size = value_shape[axis_]
        mask_size = mask_shape[axis_]
        if mask_size == 1
            broadcast_factor *= value_size
        else
            error_msg = "Shapes are not compatible, shapes: $mask_shape, $value_shape"
            @assert mask_size == value_size error_msg
        end
    end
    
    return sum(mask .* value, dims=axis, keepdims=keepdims) / (
        max.(sum(mask, dims=axis, keepdims=keepdims) * broadcast_factor, eps)
    )
end

struct Vec3Array
    x::Array{Float32}
    y::Array{Float32}
    z::Array{Float32}

    function Vec3Array(x, y, z)
        if eltype(x) != eltype(y) || eltype(y) != eltype(z)
            error("Type mismatch: $(eltype(x)), $(eltype(y)), $(eltype(z))")
        end
        if size(x) != size(y) || size(y) != size(z)
            error("Shape mismatch: $(size(x)), $(size(y)), $(size(z))")
        end
        new(x, y, z)
    end
end

function cross(v1::Vec3Array, v2::Vec3Array)
    new_x = v1.y .* v2.z - v1.z .* v2.y
    new_y = v1.z .* v2.x - v1.x .* v2.z
    new_z = v1.x .* v2.y - v1.y .* v2.x
    return Vec3Array(new_x, new_y, new_z)
end

function dot(v1::Vec3Array, v2::Vec3Array)
    return v1.x .* v2.x + v1.y .* v2.y + v1.z .* v2.z
end

function norm(v::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32 = 1e-6)
    norm2_val = dot(v, v)
    if epsilon > 0
        norm2_val = max.(norm2_val, epsilon^2)
    end
    return sqrt.(norm2_val)
end

function norm2(v::Vec3Array)
    return dot(v, v)
end

function normalized(v::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32 = 1e-6)
    return v / norm(v, epsilon)
end

function from_array(array)
    ndim = ndims(array)
    if ndim == 2
        return Vec3Array(array[:, 1], array[:, 2], array[:, 3])
    elseif ndim == 3
        return Vec3Array(array[:, :, 1], array[:, :, 2], array[:, :, 3])
    else
        error("Unsupported array dimensions: $ndim")
    end
end

function square_euclidean_distance(vec1::Vec3Array, vec2::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32 = 1e-6)
    difference = vec1 - vec2
    distance = dot(difference, difference)
    if epsilon > 0
        distance = max.(distance, epsilon)
    end
    return distance
end

function euclidean_distance(vec1::Vec3Array, vec2::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32 = 1e-6)
    distance_sq = square_euclidean_distance(vec1, vec2, epsilon^2)
    distance = sqrt.(distance_sq)
    return distance
end

function dihedral_angle(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array, c::Vec3Array, d::Vec3Array)
    v1 = a - b
    v2 = b - c
    v3 = d - c

    c1 = cross(v1, v2)
    c2 = cross(v3, v2)
    c3 = cross(c2, c1)

    v2_mag = norm(v2)
    return atan.(dot(c3, v2), v2_mag .* dot(c1, c2))
end

function random_gaussian_vector(shape, key::AbstractRNG, dtype=Float32)

function transform_ls(x::Array{Float64, 2}, b::Array{Float64, 2}; allow_reflection::Bool = false)::Array{Float64, 2}
    @assert size(x, 2) >= size(b, 2)
    @assert size(b, 1) == size(x, 1) "size(b, 1) = $(size(b, 1)), size(x, 1) = $(size(x, 1))"
    
    bxt = (transpose(b) * x) / size(b, 1)
    
    F = svd(bxt)
    u = F.U
    v = F.Vt
    
    r = u * transpose(v)
    if !allow_reflection
        flip = ones(Float64, size(v, 1))
        flip[end] = sign(det(r))
        r = u * Diagonal(flip) * transpose(v)
    end
    
    return r
end

function align(; x::Array{Float64, 2}, y::Array{Float64, 2}, x_indices::Array{Int64, 1}, y_indices::Array{Int64, 1})::Array{Float64, 2}
    if length(x_indices) != length(y_indices)
        throw(ArgumentError("Number of included indices must be the same for both input arrays, but got for x: $(length(x_indices)), and for y: $(length(y_indices))."))
    end
    
    x_mean = mean(x[x_indices, :], dims=1)
    y_mean = mean(y[y_indices, :], dims=1)
    
    centered_x = x .- x_mean
    centered_y = y .- y_mean
    
    t = transform_ls(centered_x[x_indices, :], centered_y[y_indices, :])
    transformed_x = centered_x * transpose(t) .+ y_mean
    
    return transformed_x
end

function deviations_from_coords(decoy_coords::Array{Float64, 2}, gt_coords::Array{Float64, 2}, align_idxs::Union{Array{Int64, 1}, Nothing} = nothing, include_idxs::Union{Array{Int64, 1}, Nothing} = nothing)::Array{Float64, 1}
    if size(decoy_coords) != size(gt_coords)
        throw(ArgumentError("decoy_coords.shape and gt_coords.shape must match. Found: $(size(decoy_coords)) and $(size(gt_coords))."))
    end
    
    if include_idxs === nothing
        include_idxs = collect(1:size(decoy_coords, 1))
    end
    if align_idxs === nothing
        align_idxs = include_idxs
    end
    
    aligned_decoy_coords = align(x=decoy_coords, y=gt_coords, x_indices=align_idxs, y_indices=align_idxs)
    deviations = [LinearAlgebra.norm(aligned_decoy_coords[i, :] - gt_coords[i, :]) for i in include_idxs]
    
    return deviations
end

function rmsd_from_coords(decoy_coords::Array{Float64, 2}, gt_coords::Array{Float64, 2}, align_idxs::Union{Array{Int64, 1}, Nothing} = nothing, include_idxs::Union{Array{Int64, 1}, Nothing} = nothing)::Float64
    deviations = deviations_from_coords(decoy_coords, gt_coords, align_idxs, include_idxs)
    return sqrt(mean(deviations .^ 2))
end

struct ArrayView
    base::Array
    shape::Tuple{Vararg{Int}} 
    strides::Tuple{Vararg{Int}} 
    offset::Union{Int, ScalarInt} 
    flatten_base::Bool 

    function ArrayView(base::Array; shape=nothing, strides=nothing, offset=0, flatten_base=true)
        if shape === nothing
            shape = size(base)
        end
        if strides === nothing
            strides = [prod(shape[i+1:end]) for i in 1:length(shape)]
        end
        if length(shape) != length(strides)
            throw(ArgumentError("`shape` and `strides` must have the same length."))
        end
        if isa(base, Array)
            if isa(offset, Int)
                if !(0 <= offset < length(base))
                    throw(ArgumentError("Invalid `offset`."))
                end
            end
            if flatten_base && ndims(base) != 1
                base = reshape(base, length(base))
            end
        end
        new(base, shape, strides, offset, flatten_base)
    end
end

function JAX_TreeUtil_tree_flatten(view::ArrayView)
    if isa(view.offset, Int)
        return (view.base,), (view.offset, view.shape, view.strides)
    else
        return (view.base, view.offset), (view.shape, view.strides)
    end
end

function JAX_TreeUtil_tree_unflatten(::Type{ArrayView}, aux_data, children)
    if length(children) == 1
        base = children[1]
        offset, shape, strides = aux_data
    else
        base, offset = children
        shape, strides = aux_data
    end
    return ArrayView(base; shape=shape, strides=strides, offset=offset)
end

Base.propertynames(::ArrayView) = (:base, :shape, :strides, :offset, :flatten_base)

function Base.getproperty(view::ArrayView, name::Symbol)
    if name == :dtype
        return eltype(getfield(view, :base))
    elseif name == :size
        return prod(getfield(view, :shape))
    elseif name == :ndim
        return length(getfield(view, :shape))
    elseif name == :T
        return transpose(view)
    elseif name == :_index_dtype
        i32_max = typemax(Int32)
        return length(getfield(view, :base)) <= i32_max ? Int32 : Int64
    elseif name == :offsets
        return offsets(view)
    else
        return getfield(view, name)
    end
end

function offsets(view::ArrayView)
    idxs = CartesianIndices(view.shape)
    return view.offset .+ sum(view.strides .* (collect(idxs) .- 1))
end

function astype(view::ArrayView, dtype::DataType)
    return ArrayView(convert(Array{dtype}, view.base); shape=view.shape, strides=view.strides, offset=view.offset, flatten_base=view.flatten_base)
end

function broadcast_to_rank(view::ArrayView, rank::Int)
    if rank < view.ndim
        throw(ArgumentError("Cannot broadcast to lower rank: $rank < $(view.ndim)."))
    end
    shape = (ntuple(i -> 1, rank - view.ndim)..., view.shape...)
    strides = (ntuple(i -> 0, rank - view.ndim)..., view.strides...)
    return ArrayView(view.base; shape=shape, strides=strides, offset=view.offset, flatten_base=view.flatten_base)
end

function broadcast_to(view::ArrayView, shape::Tuple{Vararg{Int}})
    view = broadcast_to_rank(view, length(shape))
    new_strides = Int[]
    for (dim_size, stride, target_size) in zip(view.shape, view.strides, shape)
        if dim_size == target_size
            push!(new_strides, stride)
        elseif dim_size == 1
            push!(new_strides, 0)
        else
            throw(ArgumentError("Cannot broadcast $(view.shape) to $shape."))
        end
    end
    return ArrayView(view.base; shape=shape, strides=Tuple(new_strides), offset=view.offset, flatten_base=view.flatten_base)
end

function collapse(view::ArrayView, start::Int, stop::Union{Int, Nothing}=nothing; allow_copy::Bool=false)
    if stop === nothing
        stop = view.ndim
    end
    if start < 1 || start > view.ndim || stop < 1 || stop > view.ndim
        throw(ArgumentError("Invalid dimension range passed to collapse."))
    end
    if stop < start
        throw(ArgumentError("Invalid dimension range passed to collapse: $(view.shape) [$start:$stop]"))
    end
    new_shape = (view.shape[1:start-1]..., prod(view.shape[start:stop]), view.shape[stop+1:end]...)
    return reshape(view, new_shape; allow_copy=allow_copy)
end

function Base.reshape(view::ArrayView, shape::Union{Tuple{Vararg{Int}}, AbstractVector{Int}}; allow_copy::Bool=false)
    try
        return _reshape(view, Tuple(shape))
    catch e
        if !allow_copy
            rethrow(e)
        end
    end
    return ArrayView(convert(Array, view); shape=shape)
end

function _reshape(view::ArrayView, shape::Tuple{Vararg{Int}})
    num_minus_one_dims = count(d -> d == -1, shape)
    if num_minus_one_dims > 0
        if num_minus_one_dims > 1
            throw(ArgumentError("`shape` may only contain a single `-1` dimension."))
        end
        pos = findfirst(==(-1), shape)
        shape_vec = collect(shape)
        shape_vec[pos] = view.size ÷ prod(d for d in shape if d != -1)
        shape = Tuple(shape_vec)
    end

    if prod(shape) != view.size
        throw(ArgumentError("Mismatched number of elements."))
    end

    old_shape = filter(d -> d != 1, view.shape)
    old_strides = [view.strides[i] for i in 1:length(view.strides) if view.shape[i] != 1]
    new_strides = zeros(Int, length(shape))

    old_start, old_stop = 1, 1
    new_start, new_stop = 1, 1

    while old_start <= length(old_shape) && new_start <= length(shape)
        old_axes_prod = old_shape[old_start]
        new_axes_prod = shape[new_start]
        while old_axes_prod != new_axes_prod
            if old_axes_prod < new_axes_prod
                if old_stop >= length(old_shape)
                    throw(ArgumentError("Cannot combine axes non-contiguous in memory."))
                end
                old_stop += 1
                old_axes_prod *= old_shape[old_stop]
            else
                if new_stop >= length(shape)
                    throw(ArgumentError("Cannot combine axes non-contiguous in memory."))
                end
                new_stop += 1
                new_axes_prod *= shape[new_stop]
            end
        end

        for i in old_start:(old_stop-1)
            if old_strides[i] != old_shape[i+1] * old_strides[i+1]
                throw(ArgumentError("Cannot combine axes non-contiguous in memory."))
            end
        end

        new_strides[new_stop] = old_strides[old_stop]
        for i in new_stop:-1:(new_start+1)
            new_strides[i-1] = new_strides[i] * shape[i]
        end

        old_start = old_stop + 1
        new_start = new_stop + 1
    end

    return ArrayView(view.base; shape=shape, strides=Tuple(new_strides), offset=view.offset, flatten_base=view.flatten_base)
end

function split(view::ArrayView, indices_or_sections::Union{Int, AbstractVector{Int}}, axis::Int=1)
    axis = mod(axis - 1, view.ndim) + 1
    if isa(indices_or_sections, Int)
        if view.shape[axis] % indices_or_sections != 0
            throw(ArgumentError("Axis size is not divisible by number of sections."))
        end
        chunk = view.shape[axis] ÷ indices_or_sections
        indices_or_sections = collect(i * chunk for i in 1:(indices_or_sections-1))
    end

    los = vcat(0, indices_or_sections)
    his = vcat(indices_or_sections, view.shape[axis])
    slice_prefix = ntuple(i -> Colon(), axis-1)
    return [view[ntuple(i -> Colon(), axis-1)..., lo+1:hi, ntuple(i -> Colon(), view.ndim-axis)...] for (lo, hi) in zip(los, his)]
end

function swapaxes(view::ArrayView, axis1::Int, axis2::Int)
    axis1 = mod(axis1 - 1, view.ndim) + 1
    axis2 = mod(axis2 - 1, view.ndim) + 1
    axes = collect(1:view.ndim)
    axes[axis1], axes[axis2] = axes[axis2], axes[axis1]
    return transpose(view, axes)
end

function moveaxis(view::ArrayView, source::Int, destination::Int)
    source = mod(source - 1, view.ndim) + 1
    destination = mod(destination - 1, view.ndim) + 1
    axes = collect(1:view.ndim)
    src_elem = axes[source]
    deleteat!(axes, source)
    insert!(axes, destination, src_elem)
    return transpose(view, axes)
end

function transpose(view::ArrayView, axes::Union{AbstractVector{Int}, Nothing}=nothing)
    if axes === nothing
        axes = reverse(1:view.ndim)
    end
    if length(axes) != view.ndim
        throw(ArgumentError("`axes` must have the same dimensionality as the array."))
    end
    shape = Tuple(view.shape[a] for a in axes)
    strides = Tuple(view.strides[a] for a in axes)
    return ArrayView(view.base; shape=shape, strides=strides, offset=view.offset, flatten_base=view.flatten_base)
end

function Base.getindex(view::ArrayView, idxs::Union{Indexer, Tuple{Vararg{Indexer}}})
    if !isa(idxs, Tuple)
        idxs = (idxs,)
    end

    if length(idxs) > view.ndim
        throw(ArgumentError("Too many slice indices."))
    end

    num_ellipses = count(x -> x == Ellipsis || x == :..., idxs)
    if num_ellipses > 1
        throw(ArgumentError("Multiple `...` are not supported."))
    elseif num_ellipses == 0
        idxs = (idxs..., Ellipsis)
    end

    ellipsis_idx = findfirst(x -> x == Ellipsis || x == :..., idxs)
    ellipsis_slices = ntuple(i -> Colon(), view.ndim - length(idxs) + 1)
    idxs = (idxs[1:ellipsis_idx-1]..., ellipsis_slices..., idxs[ellipsis_idx+1:end]...)

    shape = Int[]
    strides = Int[]
    
    function as_index(x)
        return isa(x, Array) ? convert(Array{Int}, x) : x
    end
    
    offset = as_index(view.offset)

    for (idx, dim, stride) in zip(idxs, view.shape, view.strides)
        if isa(idx, Int)
            if !(-dim <= idx < dim)
                throw(ArgumentError("Slice index out of range."))
            end
            idx_normalized = idx < 0 ? idx + dim : idx
            offset += stride * idx_normalized
        elseif isa(idx, ScalarInt)
            offset += stride * as_index(idx)
        elseif isa(idx, Colon)
            push!(shape, dim)
            push!(strides, stride)
        elseif isa(idx, Base.Slice)
            start_idx = idx.start
            stop_idx = idx.stop
            step_idx = 1
            if step_idx > 0
                push!(shape, cld(stop_idx - start_idx, step_idx))
            else
                push!(shape, cld(start_idx - stop_idx, -step_idx))
            end
            push!(strides, stride * step_idx)
            offset += stride * start_idx
        else
            throw(ArgumentError("Unexpected indexer: $idx"))
        end
    end

    return ArrayView(view.base; shape=Tuple(shape), strides=Tuple(strides), offset=offset, flatten_base=view.flatten_base)
end

function _replace(view::ArrayView; kwargs...)
    kwargs_dict = Dict(kwargs)
    base = get(kwargs_dict, :base, view.base)
    shape = get(kwargs_dict, :shape, view.shape)
    strides = get(kwargs_dict, :strides, view.strides)
    offset = get(kwargs_dict, :offset, view.offset)
    flatten_base = get(kwargs_dict, :flatten_base, view.flatten_base)
    return ArrayView(base; shape=shape, strides=strides, offset=offset, flatten_base=flatten_base)

function set(view::ArrayView, value::Union{Array, ArrayView})
    if any(s == 0 for s in view.strides)
        throw(ArgumentError("Cannot set values on a broadcasted array."))
    end

    major_to_minor = sortperm(collect(view.strides), rev=true)
    value = Array(value)
    value_transposed = permutedims(value, major_to_minor)
    if transpose(view, major_to_minor).strides == ArrayView(value_transposed).strides
        view.base[view.offset .+ (0:length(value)-1)] .= vec(value_transposed)
    else
        view.base[view.offsets] .= value
    end
    return view
end

function Base.convert(::Type{Array}, view::ArrayView)
    if view.ndim == 0 || any(s < 0 for s in view.strides)
        return view.base[view.offsets]
    end

    major_to_minor = sortperm(collect(view.strides), rev=true)

    bcast_axes = Int[]
    shape = Int[]
    for axis in reverse(major_to_minor)
        stride = view.strides[axis]
        if stride == 0
            push!(bcast_axes, axis)
            push!(shape, 1)
            continue
        end

        if stride % prod(shape) != 0
            throw(ArgumentError("Cannot express as a reshape, then slice."))
        end
        push!(shape, stride ÷ prod(shape))
    end

    if length(view.base) % prod(shape) != 0
        return view.base[view.offsets]
    end

    base_shape = (length(view.base) ÷ prod(shape), reverse(shape)...)
    slice_sizes = (map(a -> a in bcast_axes ? 1 : view.shape[a], major_to_minor)..., 1)

    if base_shape[1] == view.shape[major_to_minor[1]]
        needs_offset_slice = false
    elseif !isa(view.offset, Int)
        needs_offset_slice = true
    else
        start_indices = unravel_index(view.offset, base_shape)
        end_indices = start_indices .+ slice_sizes
        needs_offset_slice = any(end_indices .> base_shape)
    end

    if needs_offset_slice
        base_shape = (view.shape[major_to_minor[1]], base_shape[2:end]...)
        size_val = prod(base_shape)
        vals = vcat(view.base, zeros(eltype(view.base), size_val - length(view.base)))
        vals = vals[view.offset .+ (1:size_val)]
        start_indices = zeros(Int, length(base_shape))
    else
        vals = view.base
        start_indices = unravel_index(view.offset, base_shape)
    end

    vals = reshape(vals, base_shape)
    vals = vals[map((s, si) -> s:s + si - 1, start_indices, slice_sizes)...]
    vals = permutedims(vals, sortperm(major_to_minor))
    return broadcast_to(vals, view.shape)
end

function unravel_index(idx, shape)
    idxs = []
    for dim in reverse(shape)
        push!(idxs, (idx % dim) + 1)
        idx = idx ÷ dim
    end
    return reverse(idxs)
end

function _per_atom_conditioning(
    config::AtomCrossAttEncoderConfig, 
    batch::Dict{String, Any}, 
    name::String
)::Tuple{Array{Float32, 3}, Array{Float32, 4}}
    c = config
    
    positions = batch["ref_structure"]["positions"]::Array{Float32, 3}
    mask = batch["ref_structure"]["mask"]::Array{Float32, 2}
    element = batch["ref_structure"]["element"]::Array{Int32, 2}
    charge = batch["ref_structure"]["charge"]::Array{Float32, 2}
    atom_name_chars = batch["ref_structure"]["atom_name_chars"]::Array{Int32, 3}
    
    act = zeros(Float32, size(positions, 1), size(positions, 2), c.per_atom_channels)
    
    act .+= positions * rand(Float32, size(positions, 3), c.per_atom_channels)
    
    mask_exp = mask[:, :] .* ones(Float32, 1)
    act .+= mask_exp * rand(Float32, 1, c.per_atom_channels)
    
    one_hot = zeros(Float32, size(element, 1), size(element, 2), 128)
    for i in 1:size(element, 1), j in 1:size(element, 2)
        if 1 <= element[i,j] <= 128
            one_hot[i,j,element[i,j]] = 1.0f0
        end
    end
    act .+= one_hot * rand(Float32, 128, c.per_atom_channels)
    
    act .+= charge * rand(Float32, 1, c.per_atom_channels)
    
    act .+= reshape(atom_name_chars, size(act, 1), size(act, 2), :) * rand(Float32, size(atom_name_chars, 3), c.per_atom_channels)
    
    act .*= mask[:, :, 1:1]
    
    row_act = relu.(act) * rand(Float32, c.per_atom_channels, c.per_atom_pair_channels)
    
    col_act = relu.(act) * rand(Float32, c.per_atom_channels, c.per_atom_pair_channels)
    
    pair_act = row_act[:, :, 1, :] .+ permutedims(col_act[:, :, 1, :], (1,3,2))
    
    pair_act .+= (positions[:, :, 1, :] .- permutedims(positions[:, :, 1, :], (1,3,2))) * rand(Float32, 3, c.per_atom_pair_channels)
    
    sq_dists = sum((positions[:, :, 1, :] .- permutedims(positions[:, :, 1, :], (1,3,2))) .^ 2, dims=4)
    
    pair_act .+= (1 ./ (1 .+ sq_dists[:, :, :, 1])) * rand(Float32, 1, c.per_atom_pair_channels)

    return act, pair_act
end

    token_atoms_mask = batch["predicted_structure_info"]["atom_mask"]::Array{Float32, 2}

    queries_mask = token_atoms_mask[:, :, 1:1]

        trunk_single_cond_ln = trunk_single_cond
        trunk_single_cond_emb = trunk_single_cond_ln * rand(Float32, size(trunk_single_cond_ln, 3), c.per_atom_channels)

    else
        queries_act = token_atoms_act * rand(Float32, size(token_atoms_act, 3), c.per_atom_channels)
        queries_act .*= queries_mask
        queries_act .+= queries_single_cond
    end

    keys_mask = queries_mask

    row_act = relu.(queries_single_cond) * rand(Float32, c.per_atom_channels, c.per_atom_pair_channels)
    
    pair_cond_keys_input = keys_single_cond
    
    col_act = relu.(pair_cond_keys_input) * rand(Float32, c.per_atom_channels, c.per_atom_pair_channels)
    
    pair_act = row_act[:, :, 1, :] .+ permutedims(col_act[:, :, 1, :], (1,3,2))

    if trunk_pair_cond !== nothing
        trunk_pair_cond_ln = trunk_pair_cond
        trunk_pair_cond_emb = trunk_pair_cond_ln * rand(Float32, size(trunk_pair_cond_ln, 4), c.per_atom_pair_channels)

        num_tokens = size(trunk_pair_cond, 1)
        tokens_to_queries = ones(Int, num_tokens, num_tokens)
        tokens_to_keys = ones(Int, num_tokens, num_tokens)
        
        trunk_pair_to_atom_pair_gather_idxs = num_tokens * tokens_to_queries[:, :, 1] .+ tokens_to_keys[:, 1, :]

    pair_act .+= (offsets * rand(Float32, 3, c.per_atom_pair_channels)) .* offsets_valid[:, :, 1, 1:1]

    sq_dists = sum(offsets .^ 2, dims=4)
    
    pair_act .+= ((1 ./ (1 .+ sq_dists[:, :, 1, 1:1])) * rand(Float32, 1, c.per_atom_pair_channels)) .* offsets_valid[:, :, 1, 1:1]
    
    pair_act .+= offsets_valid[:, :, 1, 1:1] * rand(Float32, 1, c.per_atom_pair_channels)

    pair_act2 = relu.(pair_act) * rand(Float32, c.per_atom_pair_channels, c.per_atom_pair_channels)
    
    pair_act2 = relu.(pair_act2) * rand(Float32, c.per_atom_pair_channels, c.per_atom_pair_channels)

    queries_act .*= queries_mask
    skip_connection = queries_act

        relu.(token_atoms_act),

    )

    return AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput(
        token_act=token_act,
        skip_connection=skip_connection,
        queries_mask=queries_mask,
        queries_single_cond=queries_single_cond,
        keys_mask=keys_mask,
        keys_single_cond=keys_single_cond,
        pair_cond=pair_act,
    )
end

    if mask !== nothing
        q_len_or_indices = q_indices === nothing ? size(q, ndims(q)-2) : length(q_indices)
        k_len_or_indices = k_indices === nothing ? size(k, ndims(k)-2) : length(k_indices)
        mask_array = as_array(mask, q_len_or_indices, k_len_or_indices)
        
        mask_value = float(typemin(eltype(logits)))
        logits = Base.ifelse.(mask_array, logits, mask_value)
    end
    
    weights = _softmax(logits)
    weights = convert(Array{eltype(v)}, weights)
    
    out = einsum_with_dot_precision("...hqk,...khd->...qhd", weights, v, precision=weights_v_dot_precision)
    out = convert(Array{eltype(q)}, out)
    
    return out
end

function _fwd(
    self::XlaDotProductAttention,

    v::AbstractArray;
    q_k_dot_precision::DotPrecision,

function einsum(subscript::String, arrays::AbstractArray...)
    if subscript == "...qhd,...khd->...hqk"
        return compute_attention_scores(arrays[1], arrays[2])
    elseif subscript == "...hqk,...khd->...qhd"
        return compute_attention_output(arrays[1], arrays[2])
    else
        error("Unsupported einsum operation: $subscript")
    end
end

function compute_attention_scores(q::AbstractArray, k::AbstractArray)
    q_shape = size(q)
    k_shape = size(k)
    
    q_reshaped = reshape(q, prod(q_shape[1:end-2]), q_shape[end-1], q_shape[end])
    k_reshaped = reshape(k, prod(k_shape[1:end-2]), k_shape[end-1], k_shape[end])
    
    scores = Array{Float32}(undef, size(q_reshaped, 1), size(q_reshaped, 2), size(k_reshaped, 2))
    
    for i in 1:size(q_reshaped, 1)
        scores[i, :, :] = q_reshaped[i, :, :] * transpose(k_reshaped[i, :, :])
    end
    
    return reshape(scores, q_shape[1:end-2]..., size(scores, 2), size(scores, 3))
end

function compute_attention_output(weights::AbstractArray, v::AbstractArray)
    weights_shape = size(weights)
    v_shape = size(v)
    
    weights_reshaped = reshape(weights, prod(weights_shape[1:end-2]), weights_shape[end-1], weights_shape[end])
    v_reshaped = reshape(v, prod(v_shape[1:end-2]), v_shape[end-1], v_shape[end])
    
    output = Array{Float32}(undef, size(weights_reshaped, 1), size(weights_reshaped, 2), size(v_reshaped, 3))
    
    for i in 1:size(weights_reshaped, 1)
        output[i, :, :] = weights_reshaped[i, :, :] * v_reshaped[i, :, :]
    end
    
    return reshape(output, weights_shape[1:end-2]..., size(output, 2), v_shape[end])
end

function mask_mean(mask, value; axis=nothing, keepdims=false, eps=1e-10)
    mask_shape = size(mask)
    value_shape = size(value)
    
    @assert length(mask_shape) == length(value_shape) "Shapes are not compatible, shapes: $mask_shape, $value_shape"
    
    if typeof(axis) <: Integer
        axis = [axis]
    elseif axis === nothing
        axis = collect(1:length(mask_shape))
    end
    
    @assert typeof(axis) <: AbstractArray "axis needs to be either an iterable, integer or \"nothing\""
    
    broadcast_factor = 1.0
    for axis_ in axis
        value_size = value_shape[axis_]
        mask_size = mask_shape[axis_]
        if mask_size == 1
            broadcast_factor *= value_size
        else
            error_msg = "Shapes are not compatible, shapes: $mask_shape, $value_shape"
            @assert mask_size == value_size error_msg
        end
    end
    
    return sum(mask .* value, dims=axis, keepdims=keepdims) / (
        max.(sum(mask, dims=axis, keepdims=keepdims) * broadcast_factor, eps)
    )
end

struct Vec3Array

function cross(v1::Vec3Array, v2::Vec3Array)
    new_x = v1.y .* v2.z - v1.z .* v2.y
    new_y = v1.z .* v2.x - v1.x .* v2.z
    new_z = v1.x .* v2.y - v1.y .* v2.x
    return Vec3Array(new_x, new_y, new_z)
end

function dot(v1::Vec3Array, v2::Vec3Array)
    return v1.x .* v2.x + v1.y .* v2.y + v1.z .* v2.z
end

function norm(v::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32 = 1e-6)
    norm2_val = dot(v, v)
    if epsilon > 0
        norm2_val = max.(norm2_val, epsilon^2)
    end
    return sqrt.(norm2_val)
end

function norm2(v::Vec3Array)
    return dot(v, v)
end

function normalized(v::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32 = 1e-6)
    return v / norm(v, epsilon)
end

function zeros(::Type{Vec3Array}, shape, dtype=Float32)

        zeros(dtype, shape),

    )

function to_array(v::Vec3Array)
    return cat(v.x, v.y, v.z; dims=ndims(v.x)+1)
end

function from_array(array)
    ndim = ndims(array)
    if ndim == 2
        return Vec3Array(array[:, 1], array[:, 2], array[:, 3])
    elseif ndim == 3
        return Vec3Array(array[:, :, 1], array[:, :, 2], array[:, :, 3])
    else
        error("Unsupported array dimensions: $ndim")
    end
end

function square_euclidean_distance(vec1::Vec3Array, vec2::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32 = 1e-6)
    difference = vec1 - vec2
    distance = dot(difference, difference)
    if epsilon > 0
        distance = max.(distance, epsilon)
    end
    return distance
end

function euclidean_distance(vec1::Vec3Array, vec2::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32 = 1e-6)
    distance_sq = square_euclidean_distance(vec1, vec2, epsilon^2)
    distance = sqrt.(distance_sq)
    return distance
end

function dihedral_angle(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array, c::Vec3Array, d::Vec3Array)
    v1 = a - b
    v2 = b - c
    v3 = d - c

    c1 = cross(v1, v2)
    c2 = cross(v3, v2)
    c3 = cross(c2, c1)

    v2_mag = norm(v2)
    return atan.(dot(c3, v2), v2_mag .* dot(c1, c2))
end

function random_gaussian_vector(shape, key::AbstractRNG, dtype=Float32)
    vec_array = randn(key, dtype, (shape..., 3))
    return from_array(vec_array)
end

function transform_ls(x::Array{Float64, 2}, b::Array{Float64, 2}; allow_reflection::Bool = false)::Array{Float64, 2}
    @assert size(x, 2) >= size(b, 2)
    @assert size(b, 1) == size(x, 1) "size(b, 1) = $(size(b, 1)), size(x, 1) = $(size(x, 1))"
    
    bxt = (transpose(b) * x) / size(b, 1)
    
    F = svd(bxt)
    u = F.U
    v = F.Vt
    
    r = u * transpose(v)
    if !allow_reflection
        flip = ones(Float64, size(v, 1))
        flip[end] = sign(det(r))
        r = u * Diagonal(flip) * transpose(v)
    end
    
    return r
end

function align(; x::Array{Float64, 2}, y::Array{Float64, 2}, x_indices::Array{Int64, 1}, y_indices::Array{Int64, 1})::Array{Float64, 2}
    if length(x_indices) != length(y_indices)
        throw(ArgumentError("Number of included indices must be the same for both input arrays, but got for x: $(length(x_indices)), and for y: $(length(y_indices))."))
    end
    
    x_mean = mean(x[x_indices, :], dims=1)
    y_mean = mean(y[y_indices, :], dims=1)
    
    centered_x = x .- x_mean
    centered_y = y .- y_mean
    
    t = transform_ls(centered_x[x_indices, :], centered_y[y_indices, :])
    transformed_x = centered_x * transpose(t) .+ y_mean
    
    return transformed_x
end

function deviations_from_coords(decoy_coords::Array{Float64, 2}, gt_coords::Array{Float64, 2}, align_idxs::Union{Array{Int64, 1}, Nothing} = nothing, include_idxs::Union{Array{Int64, 1}, Nothing} = nothing)::Array{Float64, 1}
    if size(decoy_coords) != size(gt_coords)
        throw(ArgumentError("decoy_coords.shape and gt_coords.shape must match. Found: $(size(decoy_coords)) and $(size(gt_coords))."))
    end
    
    if include_idxs === nothing
        include_idxs = collect(1:size(decoy_coords, 1))
    end
    if align_idxs === nothing
        align_idxs = include_idxs
    end
    
    aligned_decoy_coords = align(x=decoy_coords, y=gt_coords, x_indices=align_idxs, y_indices=align_idxs)
    deviations = [LinearAlgebra.norm(aligned_decoy_coords[i, :] - gt_coords[i, :]) for i in include_idxs]
    
    return deviations
end

function rmsd_from_coords(decoy_coords::Array{Float64, 2}, gt_coords::Array{Float64, 2}, align_idxs::Union{Array{Int64, 1}, Nothing} = nothing, include_idxs::Union{Array{Int64, 1}, Nothing} = nothing)::Float64
    deviations = deviations_from_coords(decoy_coords, gt_coords, align_idxs, include_idxs)
    return sqrt(mean(deviations .^ 2))
end

struct ArrayView
    base::Array
    shape::Tuple{Vararg{Int}} 
    strides::Tuple{Vararg{Int}} 
    offset::Union{Int, ScalarInt} 
    flatten_base::Bool 

    function ArrayView(base::Array; shape=nothing, strides=nothing, offset=0, flatten_base=true)
        if shape === nothing
            shape = size(base)
        end
        if strides === nothing
            strides = [prod(shape[i+1:end]) for i in 1:length(shape)]
        end
        if length(shape) != length(strides)
            throw(ArgumentError("`shape` and `strides` must have the same length."))
        end
        if isa(base, Array)
            if isa(offset, Int)
                if !(0 <= offset < length(base))
                    throw(ArgumentError("Invalid `offset`."))
                end
            end
            if flatten_base && ndims(base) != 1
                base = reshape(base, length(base))
            end
        end
        new(base, shape, strides, offset, flatten_base)
    end
end

function JAX_TreeUtil_tree_flatten(view::ArrayView)
    if isa(view.offset, Int)
        return (view.base,), (view.offset, view.shape, view.strides)
    else
        return (view.base, view.offset), (view.shape, view.strides)
    end
end

function JAX_TreeUtil_tree_unflatten(::Type{ArrayView}, aux_data, children)
    if length(children) == 1
        base = children[1]
        offset, shape, strides = aux_data
    else
        base, offset = children
        shape, strides = aux_data
    end
    return ArrayView(base; shape=shape, strides=strides, offset=offset)
end

Base.propertynames(::ArrayView) = (:base, :shape, :strides, :offset, :flatten_base)

function Base.getproperty(view::ArrayView, name::Symbol)
    if name == :dtype
        return eltype(getfield(view, :base))
    elseif name == :size
        return prod(getfield(view, :shape))
    elseif name == :ndim
        return length(getfield(view, :shape))
    elseif name == :T
        return transpose(view)
    elseif name == :_index_dtype
        i32_max = typemax(Int32)
        return length(getfield(view, :base)) <= i32_max ? Int32 : Int64
    elseif name == :offsets
        return offsets(view)
    else
        return getfield(view, name)
    end
end

function offsets(view::ArrayView)
    idxs = CartesianIndices(view.shape)
    return view.offset .+ sum(view.strides .* (collect(idxs) .- 1))
end

function astype(view::ArrayView, dtype::DataType)
    return ArrayView(convert(Array{dtype}, view.base); shape=view.shape, strides=view.strides, offset=view.offset, flatten_base=view.flatten_base)
end

function broadcast_to_rank(view::ArrayView, rank::Int)
    if rank < view.ndim
        throw(ArgumentError("Cannot broadcast to lower rank: $rank < $(view.ndim)."))
    end
    shape = (ntuple(i -> 1, rank - view.ndim)..., view.shape...)
    strides = (ntuple(i -> 0, rank - view.ndim)..., view.strides...)
    return ArrayView(view.base; shape=shape, strides=strides, offset=view.offset, flatten_base=view.flatten_base)
end

function broadcast_to(view::ArrayView, shape::Tuple{Vararg{Int}})
    view = broadcast_to_rank(view, length(shape))
    new_strides = Int[]
    for (dim_size, stride, target_size) in zip(view.shape, view.strides, shape)
        if dim_size == target_size
            push!(new_strides, stride)
        elseif dim_size == 1
            push!(new_strides, 0)
        else
            throw(ArgumentError("Cannot broadcast $(view.shape) to $shape."))
        end
    end
    return ArrayView(view.base; shape=shape, strides=Tuple(new_strides), offset=view.offset, flatten_base=view.flatten_base)
end

function collapse(view::ArrayView, start::Int, stop::Union{Int, Nothing}=nothing; allow_copy::Bool=false)
    if stop === nothing
        stop = view.ndim
    end
    if start < 1 || start > view.ndim || stop < 1 || stop > view.ndim
        throw(ArgumentError("Invalid dimension range passed to collapse."))
    end
    if stop < start
        throw(ArgumentError("Invalid dimension range passed to collapse: $(view.shape) [$start:$stop]"))
    end
    new_shape = (view.shape[1:start-1]..., prod(view.shape[start:stop]), view.shape[stop+1:end]...)
    return reshape(view, new_shape; allow_copy=allow_copy)
end

function Base.reshape(view::ArrayView, shape::Union{Tuple{Vararg{Int}}, AbstractVector{Int}}; allow_copy::Bool=false)
    try
        return _reshape(view, Tuple(shape))
    catch e
        if !allow_copy
            rethrow(e)
        end
    end
    return ArrayView(convert(Array, view); shape=shape)
end

function _reshape(view::ArrayView, shape::Tuple{Vararg{Int}})
    num_minus_one_dims = count(d -> d == -1, shape)
    if num_minus_one_dims > 0
        if num_minus_one_dims > 1
            throw(ArgumentError("`shape` may only contain a single `-1` dimension."))
        end
        pos = findfirst(==(-1), shape)
        shape_vec = collect(shape)
        shape_vec[pos] = view.size ÷ prod(d for d in shape if d != -1)
        shape = Tuple(shape_vec)
    end

    if prod(shape) != view.size
        throw(ArgumentError("Mismatched number of elements."))
    end

    old_shape = filter(d -> d != 1, view.shape)
    old_strides = [view.strides[i] for i in 1:length(view.strides) if view.shape[i] != 1]
    new_strides = zeros(Int, length(shape))

    old_start, old_stop = 1, 1
    new_start, new_stop = 1, 1

    while old_start <= length(old_shape) && new_start <= length(shape)
        old_axes_prod = old_shape[old_start]
        new_axes_prod = shape[new_start]
        while old_axes_prod != new_axes_prod
            if old_axes_prod < new_axes_prod
                if old_stop >= length(old_shape)
                    throw(ArgumentError("Cannot combine axes non-contiguous in memory."))
                end
                old_stop += 1
                old_axes_prod *= old_shape[old_stop]
            else
                if new_stop >= length(shape)
                    throw(ArgumentError("Cannot combine axes non-contiguous in memory."))
                end
                new_stop += 1
                new_axes_prod *= shape[new_stop]
            end
        end

        for i in old_start:(old_stop-1)
            if old_strides[i] != old_shape[i+1] * old_strides[i+1]
                throw(ArgumentError("Cannot combine axes non-contiguous in memory."))
            end
        end

        new_strides[new_stop] = old_strides[old_stop]
        for i in new_stop:-1:(new_start+1)
            new_strides[i-1] = new_strides[i] * shape[i]
        end

        old_start = old_stop + 1
        new_start = new_stop + 1
    end

    return ArrayView(view.base; shape=shape, strides=Tuple(new_strides), offset=view.offset, flatten_base=view.flatten_base)
end

function split(view::ArrayView, indices_or_sections::Union{Int, AbstractVector{Int}}, axis::Int=1)
    axis = mod(axis - 1, view.ndim) + 1
    if isa(indices_or_sections, Int)
        if view.shape[axis] % indices_or_sections != 0
            throw(ArgumentError("Axis size is not divisible by number of sections."))
        end
        chunk = view.shape[axis] ÷ indices_or_sections
        indices_or_sections = collect(i * chunk for i in 1:(indices_or_sections-1))
    end

    los = vcat(0, indices_or_sections)
    his = vcat(indices_or_sections, view.shape[axis])
    slice_prefix = ntuple(i -> Colon(), axis-1)
    return [view[ntuple(i -> Colon(), axis-1)..., lo+1:hi, ntuple(i -> Colon(), view.ndim-axis)...] for (lo, hi) in zip(los, his)]
end

function swapaxes(view::ArrayView, axis1::Int, axis2::Int)
    axis1 = mod(axis1 - 1, view.ndim) + 1
    axis2 = mod(axis2 - 1, view.ndim) + 1
    axes = collect(1:view.ndim)
    axes[axis1], axes[axis2] = axes[axis2], axes[axis1]
    return transpose(view, axes)
end

function moveaxis(view::ArrayView, source::Int, destination::Int)
    source = mod(source - 1, view.ndim) + 1
    destination = mod(destination - 1, view.ndim) + 1
    axes = collect(1:view.ndim)
    src_elem = axes[source]
    deleteat!(axes, source)
    insert!(axes, destination, src_elem)
    return transpose(view, axes)
end

function transpose(view::ArrayView, axes::Union{AbstractVector{Int}, Nothing}=nothing)
    if axes === nothing
        axes = reverse(1:view.ndim)
    end
    if length(axes) != view.ndim
        throw(ArgumentError("`axes` must have the same dimensionality as the array."))
    end
    shape = Tuple(view.shape[a] for a in axes)
    strides = Tuple(view.strides[a] for a in axes)
    return ArrayView(view.base; shape=shape, strides=strides, offset=view.offset, flatten_base=view.flatten_base)
end

function Base.getindex(view::ArrayView, idxs::Union{Indexer, Tuple{Vararg{Indexer}}})
    if !isa(idxs, Tuple)
        idxs = (idxs,)
    end

    if length(idxs) > view.ndim
        throw(ArgumentError("Too many slice indices."))
    end

    num_ellipses = count(x -> x == Ellipsis || x == :..., idxs)
    if num_ellipses > 1
        throw(ArgumentError("Multiple `...` are not supported."))
    elseif num_ellipses == 0
        idxs = (idxs..., Ellipsis)
    end

    ellipsis_idx = findfirst(x -> x == Ellipsis || x == :..., idxs)
    ellipsis_slices = ntuple(i -> Colon(), view.ndim - length(idxs) + 1)
    idxs = (idxs[1:ellipsis_idx-1]..., ellipsis_slices..., idxs[ellipsis_idx+1:end]...)

    shape = Int[]
    strides = Int[]
    
    function as_index(x)
        return isa(x, Array) ? convert(Array{Int}, x) : x
    end
    
    offset = as_index(view.offset)

    for (idx, dim, stride) in zip(idxs, view.shape, view.strides)
        if isa(idx, Int)
            if !(-dim <= idx < dim)
                throw(ArgumentError("Slice index out of range."))
            end
            idx_normalized = idx < 0 ? idx + dim : idx
            offset += stride * idx_normalized
        elseif isa(idx, ScalarInt)
            offset += stride * as_index(idx)
        elseif isa(idx, Colon)
            push!(shape, dim)
            push!(strides, stride)
        elseif isa(idx, Base.Slice)
            start_idx = idx.start
            stop_idx = idx.stop
            step_idx = 1
            if step_idx > 0
                push!(shape, cld(stop_idx - start_idx, step_idx))
            else
                push!(shape, cld(start_idx - stop_idx, -step_idx))
            end
            push!(strides, stride * step_idx)
            offset += stride * start_idx
        else
            throw(ArgumentError("Unexpected indexer: $idx"))
        end
    end

    return ArrayView(view.base; shape=Tuple(shape), strides=Tuple(strides), offset=offset, flatten_base=view.flatten_base)
end

function _replace(view::ArrayView; kwargs...)
    kwargs_dict = Dict(kwargs)
    base = get(kwargs_dict, :base, view.base)
    shape = get(kwargs_dict, :shape, view.shape)
    strides = get(kwargs_dict, :strides, view.strides)
    offset = get(kwargs_dict, :offset, view.offset)
    flatten_base = get(kwargs_dict, :flatten_base, view.flatten_base)
    return ArrayView(base; shape=shape, strides=strides, offset=offset, flatten_base=flatten_base)
end

function set(view::ArrayView, value::Union{Array, ArrayView})
    if any(s == 0 for s in view.strides)
        throw(ArgumentError("Cannot set values on a broadcasted array."))
    end

    major_to_minor = sortperm(collect(view.strides), rev=true)
    value = Array(value)
    value_transposed = permutedims(value, major_to_minor)
    if transpose(view, major_to_minor).strides == ArrayView(value_transposed).strides
        view.base[view.offset .+ (0:length(value)-1)] .= vec(value_transposed)
    else
        view.base[view.offsets] .= value
    end
    return view
end

function Base.convert(::Type{Array}, view::ArrayView)
    if view.ndim == 0 || any(s < 0 for s in view.strides)
        return view.base[view.offsets]
    end

    major_to_minor = sortperm(collect(view.strides), rev=true)

    bcast_axes = Int[]
    shape = Int[]
    for axis in reverse(major_to_minor)
        stride = view.strides[axis]
        if stride == 0
            push!(bcast_axes, axis)
            push!(shape, 1)
            continue
        end

        if stride % prod(shape) != 0
            throw(ArgumentError("Cannot express as a reshape, then slice."))
        end
        push!(shape, stride ÷ prod(shape))
    end

    if length(view.base) % prod(shape) != 0
        return view.base[view.offsets]
    end

    base_shape = (length(view.base) ÷ prod(shape), reverse(shape)...)
    slice_sizes = (map(a -> a in bcast_axes ? 1 : view.shape[a], major_to_minor)..., 1)

    if base_shape[1] == view.shape[major_to_minor[1]]
        needs_offset_slice = false
    elseif !isa(view.offset, Int)
        needs_offset_slice = true
    else
        start_indices = unravel_index(view.offset, base_shape)
        end_indices = start_indices .+ slice_sizes
        needs_offset_slice = any(end_indices .> base_shape)
    end

    if needs_offset_slice
        base_shape = (view.shape[major_to_minor[1]], base_shape[2:end]...)
        size_val = prod(base_shape)
        vals = vcat(view.base, zeros(eltype(view.base), size_val - length(view.base)))
        vals = vals[view.offset .+ (1:size_val)]
        start_indices = zeros(Int, length(base_shape))
    else
        vals = view.base
        start_indices = unravel_index(view.offset, base_shape)
    end

    vals = reshape(vals, base_shape)
    vals = vals[map((s, si) -> s:s + si - 1, start_indices, slice_sizes)...]
    vals = permutedims(vals, sortperm(major_to_minor))
    return broadcast_to(vals, view.shape)
end

    end

function _per_atom_conditioning(
    config::AtomCrossAttEncoderConfig, 
    batch::Dict{String, Any}, 
    name::String
)::Tuple{Array{Float32,3}, Array{Float32,4}}
    c = config
    pos = batch["ref_structure"]["positions"]::Array{Float32,3}          # (B, A, 3)
    mask = batch["ref_structure"]["mask"]::Array{Float32,2}               # (B, A)
    elem = batch["ref_structure"]["element"]::Array{Int32,2}              # (B, A)
    charge = batch["ref_structure"]["charge"]::Array{Float32,2}           # (B, A)
    atom_name_chars = batch["ref_structure"]["atom_name_chars"]::Array{Int32,3}  # (B, A, C)

    B, A = size(pos, 1), size(pos, 2)
    C = c.per_atom_channels
    PCP = c.per_atom_pair_channels

    Wp = rand(Float32, 3, C)
    Wm = rand(Float32, 1, C)
    We = rand(Float32, 128, C)
    Wc = rand(Float32, 1, C)
    Wn = rand(Float32, size(atom_name_chars, 3), C)

    act = zeros(Float32, B, A, C)
    act .+= Array{Float32}(pos) * Wp
    act .+= reshape(Array{Float32}(mask), B, A, 1) .* reshape(Wm, 1, 1, :)
    one_hot = _one_hot_int(elem, 128)
    act .+= one_hot * We
    act .+= reshape(charge, B, A, 1) .* reshape(Wc, 1, 1, :)
    act .+= Array{Float32}(atom_name_chars) * Wn
    act .*= reshape(Array{Float32}(mask), B, A, 1)

    Wr = rand(Float32, C, PCP)
    Wc2 = rand(Float32, C, PCP)
    row_act = max.(act, 0) * Wr                     # (B, A, PCP)
    col_act = max.(act, 0) * Wc2                    # (B, A, PCP)

    pair_act = reshape(row_act, B, A, 1, PCP) .+ reshape(col_act, B, 1, A, PCP)

    Wo = rand(Float32, 3, PCP)
    offsets = reshape(pos, B, A, 1, 3) .- reshape(pos, B, 1, A, 3)    # (B, A, A, 3)
    pair_act .+= (offsets * Wo)                                       # (B, A, A, PCP)

    sq_dists = sum(offsets .* offsets; dims=4)                         # (B, A, A, 1)
    wd = rand(Float32, 1, 1, 1, PCP)
    pair_act .+= (1.0f0 ./ (1.0f0 .+ sq_dists)) .* wd

    return act, pair_act
end

function _choose_heads(channels::Int)
    for h in (16, 8, 4, 2, 1)
        if channels % h == 0
            return h, div(channels, h)
        end
    end
    return 1, channels
end

function _split_heads(x::Array{Float32,3}, h::Int)
    B, A, C = size(x)
    if C % h != 0
        error("Channels not divisible by heads")
    end
    d = div(C, h)
    return reshape(x, B, A, h, d)
end

function _merge_heads(x::Array{Float32,4})
    B, A, h, d = size(x)
    return reshape(x, B, A, h*d)
end

function atom_cross_att_encoder(
    token_atoms_act::Union{Array{Float32,3}, Nothing},
    trunk_single_cond::Union{Array{Float32,3}, Nothing},
    trunk_pair_cond::Union{Array{Float32,4}, Nothing},
    config::AtomCrossAttEncoderConfig,
    global_config::Dict{String, Any},
    batch::Dict{String, Any},
    name::String
)::AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput
    c = config

    token_atoms_single_cond, pair_act = _per_atom_conditioning(config, batch, name)  # (B,A,C), (B,A,A,PCP)
    token_atoms_mask = batch["predicted_structure_info"]["atom_mask"]::Array{Float32,2} # (B,A)
    queries_single_cond = token_atoms_single_cond
    queries_mask = reshape(token_atoms_mask, size(token_atoms_mask,1), size(token_atoms_mask,2), 1)

    if trunk_single_cond !== nothing
        Ws = rand(Float32, size(trunk_single_cond, 3), c.per_atom_channels)
        queries_single_cond .+= trunk_single_cond * Ws
    end

    if token_atoms_act === nothing
        queries_act = queries_single_cond
    else
        Wq = rand(Float32, size(token_atoms_act, 3), c.per_atom_channels)
        queries_act = token_atoms_act * Wq
        queries_act .*= queries_mask
        queries_act .+= queries_single_cond
    end

    keys_single_cond = queries_single_cond
    keys_mask = queries_mask

    if trunk_pair_cond !== nothing
        pair_act .+= trunk_pair_cond
    end

    h, d = _choose_heads(c.per_atom_channels)
    q = _split_heads(queries_act, h)        # (B,A,h,d)
    k = _split_heads(keys_single_cond, h)   # (B,A,h,d)
    v = _split_heads(queries_act, h)        # (B,A,h,d)

    out = _attend(q, k, v;
        q_k_dot_precision=F32_F32,
        logits_dtype=Float32,
        logits_scale=1.0,
        bias=nothing,
        mask=nothing,
        weights_v_dot_precision=F32_F32
    )                                        # (B,A,h,d)

    out = out .* queries_mask
    skip_connection = out
    Wt = rand(Float32, c.per_atom_channels, c.per_token_channels)
    token_atoms_act2 = _merge_heads(out) * Wt
    token_act = mask_mean(queries_mask, max.(token_atoms_act2, 0f0); axis=2, keepdims=true)

    return AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput(
        token_act,
        skip_connection,
        queries_mask,
        queries_single_cond,
        keys_mask,
        keys_single_cond,
        pair_act
    )

    weights_v_dot_precision::DotPrecision,
    q_indices::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing} = nothing,
    k_indices::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing} = nothing
)
    return _attend(
        q, k, v,
        bias=bias,
        mask=mask,
        q_indices=q_indices,
        k_indices=k_indices,
        q_k_dot_precision=q_k_dot_precision,
        logits_dtype=logits_dtype,

function einsum(subscript::String, arrays::AbstractArray...)
    if subscript == "...qhd,...khd->...hqk"
        return compute_attention_scores(arrays[1], arrays[2])
    elseif subscript == "...hqk,...khd->...qhd"
        return compute_attention_output(arrays[1], arrays[2])
    else
        error("Unsupported einsum operation: $subscript")
    end
end

function _batched_mat_mul(a::AbstractArray, b::AbstractArray)
    B = size(a, 1)
    res = similar(a, B, size(a, 2), size(b, 3))
    for i in 1:B
        res[i, :, :] = a[i, :, :] * b[i, :, :]
    end
    return res
end

function compute_attention_scores(q::AbstractArray, k::AbstractArray)
    lead_shape = size(q)[1:end-3]
    B = prod(lead_shape)
    q_len, h, d_k = size(q)[end-2:end]
    k_len = size(k)[end-2]

    q_r = reshape(permutedims(q, (vcat(collect(1:length(lead_shape))...), length(lead_shape)+2, length(lead_shape)+1, length(lead_shape)+3)), B * h, q_len, d_k)
    k_r = reshape(permutedims(k, (vcat(collect(1:length(lead_shape))...), length(lead_shape)+2, length(lead_shape)+3, length(lead_shape)+1)), B * h, d_k, k_len)
    
    scores = _batched_mat_mul(q_r, k_r)
    
    return reshape(scores, lead_shape..., h, q_len, k_len)
end

function compute_attention_output(weights::AbstractArray, v::AbstractArray)
    lead_shape = size(weights)[1:end-3]
    B = prod(lead_shape)
    h, q_len, k_len = size(weights)[end-2:end]
    d_v = size(v)[end]

    weights_r = reshape(weights, B * h, q_len, k_len)
    v_r = reshape(permutedims(v, (vcat(collect(1:length(lead_shape))...), length(lead_shape)+2, length(lead_shape)+1, length(lead_shape)+3)), B * h, k_len, d_v)
    
    output = _batched_mat_mul(weights_r, v_r)
    
    output_permuted = permutedims(reshape(output, lead_shape..., h, q_len, d_v), (vcat(collect(1:length(lead_shape))...), length(lead_shape)+2, length(lead_shape)+1, length(lead_shape)+3))

    return reshape(output_permuted, lead_shape..., q_len, h, d_v)
end

function as_array(mask::Mask, q_len, k_len)
    return ones(Bool, q_len, k_len)

function mask_mean(mask, value; axis=nothing, keepdims=false, eps=1e-10)
    if axis isa Integer
        axis = [axis]
    elseif axis === nothing
        axis = collect(1:ndims(mask))
    end
    
    denom = sum(mask, dims=axis, keepdims=keepdims)
    num = sum(mask .* value, dims=axis, keepdims=keepdims)
    
    return num ./ max.(denom, eps)
end

function dihedral_angle(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array, c::Vec3Array, d::Vec3Array)

function _per_atom_conditioning(
    c::AtomCrossAttEncoderConfig, 
    weights::PerAtomConditioningWeights,
    batch::Dict{String, Any}
)::Tuple{Array{Float32, 3}, Array{Float32, 4}}
    positions = batch["ref_structure"]["positions"]::Array{Float32, 3}
    mask = batch["ref_structure"]["mask"]::Array{Float32, 2}
    element = batch["ref_structure"]["element"]::Array{Int32, 2}
    charge = batch["ref_structure"]["charge"]::Array{Float32, 2}
    atom_name_chars = batch["ref_structure"]["atom_name_chars"]::Array{Int32, 3}
    
    act = zeros(Float32, size(positions, 1), size(positions, 2), c.per_atom_channels)
    act .+= positions * weights.Wp
    act .+= reshape(mask, size(mask)..., 1) * weights.Wm
    one_hot = Float32.(_one_hot_int(element, 128))
    act .+= one_hot * weights.We
    act .+= reshape(charge, size(charge)..., 1) * weights.Wc
    act .+= convert(Array{Float32}, atom_name_chars) * weights.Wn
    act .*= reshape(mask, size(mask)..., 1)
    
    row_act = relu.(act) * weights.Wr
    col_act = relu.(act) * weights.Wc2
    pair_act = reshape(row_act, size(row_act, 1), size(row_act, 2), 1, :) .+ reshape(col_act, size(col_act, 1), 1, size(col_act, 2), :)
    
    offsets = reshape(positions, size(positions,1), size(positions,2), 1, 3) .- reshape(positions, size(positions,1), 1, size(positions,2), 3)
    pair_act .+= offsets * weights.Wo
    sq_dists = sum(offsets .^ 2, dims=4)
    pair_act .+= (1.0f0 ./ (1.0f0 .+ sq_dists)) * reshape(weights.Wd, 1, 1, 1, :)
    return act, pair_act
end
_one_hot_int(x, K) = [i == v for i in 1:K, v in x] |> permutedims

function atom_cross_att_encoder(
    token_atoms_act::Union{Array{Float32, 3}, Nothing},
    trunk_single_cond::Union{Array{Float32, 3}, Nothing},
    trunk_pair_cond::Union{Array{Float32, 4}, Nothing},
    config::AtomCrossAttEncoderConfig,
    weights::AtomCrossAttEncoderWeights,
    batch::Dict{String, Any}
)::AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput
    c = config
    w = weights

    token_atoms_single_cond, pair_act = _per_atom_conditioning(c, w.cond_weights, batch)
    token_atoms_mask = batch["predicted_structure_info"]["atom_mask"]::Array{Float32, 2}
    queries_single_cond = token_atoms_single_cond
    queries_mask = reshape(token_atoms_mask, size(token_atoms_mask)..., 1)

    if trunk_single_cond !== nothing
        queries_single_cond .+= trunk_single_cond * w.W_trunk_single
    end

    queries_act = (token_atoms_act === nothing) ? queries_single_cond : (token_atoms_act * w.W_token_atoms_in) .* queries_mask .+ queries_single_cond

    keys_single_cond = queries_single_cond
    keys_mask = queries_mask

    if trunk_pair_cond !== nothing
        pair_act .+= trunk_pair_cond * reshape(w.W_trunk_pair, 1, 1, size(w.W_trunk_pair)...)
    end

    queries_ref_pos = reshape(batch["ref_structure"]["positions"], size(queries_mask,1), size(queries_mask,2), 1, 3)
    offsets = queries_ref_pos .- permutedims(queries_ref_pos, (1,3,2,4))
    offsets_valid = ones(Bool, size(queries_mask, 1), size(queries_mask, 2), size(keys_mask, 2), 1)
    
    pair_act .+= (offsets * w.W_offset) .* offsets_valid
    sq_dists = sum(offsets .^ 2, dims=4)
    pair_act .+= (1.0f0 ./ (1.0f0 .+ sq_dists)) .* reshape(w.cond_weights.Wd, 1,1,1,:)
    pair_act .+= offsets_valid .* reshape(w.W_valid, 1,1,1,:)

    pair_act = relu.(pair_act) * w.W_pair1
    pair_act = relu.(pair_act) * w.W_pair2
    pair_act .+= relu.(pair_act) * w.W_pair3

    h, d = 16, c.per_atom_channels ÷ 16
    q = reshape(queries_act, size(queries_act,1), size(queries_act,2), h, d)
    k = reshape(keys_single_cond, size(keys_single_cond,1), size(keys_single_cond,2), h, d)
    v = q

    attended_act = _attend(q, k, v; q_k_dot_precision=F32_F32, logits_dtype=Float32, logits_scale=1.0, bias=nothing, mask=nothing, weights_v_dot_precision=F32_F32)
    attended_act .*= queries_mask
    skip_connection = attended_act

    attended_act_merged = reshape(attended_act, size(queries_act))
    token_atoms_act_out = attended_act_merged * w.W_out
    
    token_act = mask_mean(queries_mask, relu.(token_atoms_act_out), axis=2)

    return AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput(token_act, skip_connection, queries_mask, queries_single_cond, keys_mask, keys_single_cond, pair_act)
end

function atom_cross_att_decoder(
    token_act::Array{Float32, 3},
    enc::AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput,
    config::AtomCrossAttDecoderConfig,
    weights::AtomCrossAttDecoderWeights
)::Array{Float32, 3}
    c, w = config, weights

    max_atoms_per_token = size(enc.queries_mask, 2)
    token_atom_act = repeat(token_act_proj, 1, max_atoms_per_token, 1)
    
    queries_act = token_atom_act .+ reshape(enc.skip_connection, size(token_atom_act))
    queries_act .*= enc.queries_mask

    h, d = 16, c.per_atom_channels ÷ 16
    q = reshape(queries_act, size(queries_act,1), size(queries_act,2), h, d)
    k = reshape(enc.keys_single_cond, size(enc.keys_single_cond,1), size(enc.keys_single_cond,2), h, d)

    attended_act .*= enc.queries_mask
    
    attended_act_merged = reshape(attended_act, size(queries_act))
    position_update = attended_act_merged * w.W_pos_out
    
    return position_update
end
